scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p packages/solid-pulse --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/scenario-sim --noEmit
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run test && bun run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: bun --conditions=browser --conditions=development test packages/scenario-sim/tests && bun --conditions=browser --conditions=development test packages/solid-pulse/tests
scripts.test:e2e: bun --conditions=browser --conditions=development test packages/scenario-sim/e2e && bun --conditions=browser --conditions=development test packages/solid-pulse/e2e
